r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.

r4a-zero-fit.title: Zero-fit constraint
r4a-zero-fit.imperative: Confirm the flow-rate cap is a literal cited constant, not derived via regression anywhere in the estimator.

r4b-no-pooling.title: No cross-season/circuit pooling
r4b-no-pooling.imperative: Confirm no pooling/shrinkage/averaging across seasons or circuits inside the estimator or cross-check.

r4c-db-seam.title: DB/telemetry-store-only access, seam reuse
r4c-db-seam.imperative: Confirm no direct FastF1 imports; confirm TelemetryStore/build_db_session seam is reused, not duplicated.

r4d-mass-model-untouched.title: physics_region_no_evo_import + mass_model.py untouched
r4d-mass-model-untouched.imperative: Confirm no evo/latent_power/compound_prior imports in new files; confirm mass_model.py has zero diff and SC_BURN_FRACTION is unchanged.

triage_candidates.statement: build_db_session (src/data/telemetry_session.py) emits RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in multiply from pd.to_timedelta when a session's lap_time_s column contains NaN (observed live during this review's own validation script run). Non-crashing (NaN correctly becomes NaT, filtered downstream by dropna) but noisy across many (year,circuit) combos with 1-85 NaN lap times each. Out of this gate's scope (read-only reference file); worth a follow-up to pre-filter NaN before the pandas cast.
